{{Quote|We're not leaving. Serving you has been an honor. If you stay, we stay.|Dayn and Nira|<ref name="Dark Times—A Spark Remains 4">[[Dark Times—A Spark Remains 4|''Dark Times—A Spark Remains'' 4]]</ref>}}
'''Nira''' was a [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] that, along with [[Dayn]], served as a [[Chef/Legends|chef]] to [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kai Hudorra]] following his acquisition of [[The Lucky Twi'lek]] on [[Kestavel]].

==Biography==
Both Nira and Dayn had been serving Hudorra for some time when [[Dass Jennir]], [[Beyghor Sahdett]], and the crew of the ''[[Uhumele]]'' arrived at the casino in search of him.

After Sahdett's [[Duel on Kestavel|betrayal]], the two Bith helped clean up the bodies and debris. When Hudorra tried to force his remaining staff to flee in advance of the upcoming [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] attack, Nira, along with Dayn, [[Bryti]], [[Kal (bodyguard)|Kal]], and [[Shaylai Veila]], reaffirmed their loyalty to the Jedi Master, refusing to abandon him. The pair would later prepare a final feast, as there would be little use for the food assuming the casino's destruction in the upcoming attack. The duo would sit between Veila and [[Bomo Greenbark]] during the meal itself, where the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] told everyone that only he and Jennir would be staying.

Later, as [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] and his [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] marched across the bridge to the casino, Nira was already aboard the ''Uhumele''. Both Nira and Dayn would be witness to Hudorra's final message, recorded on a [[Hologram disc/Legends|holodisc]] given to Jennir by Bryti, wishing that [[May the Force be with you/Legends|the Force be with them]].

==Behind the scenes==
The two Bith are both named by Bryti, but it is unclear exactly which one is Nira and which is Dayn. The taller, blue-eyed Bith wore red garments, whereas the shorter green-eyed one wore brown/green ones.
